topic.title: Protected Species / Surveys / Mitigation Licensing / Monitoring
topic.source_contract: species and site identity, desk study, seasonally valid survey, population and resting-site evidence, impact assessment, avoidance, mitigation and compensation, licensing tests, Natural England licence, method statement, ecological supervision, implementation, reporting and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A desk-study record is not a current field survey.
A survey outside the valid season is not accepted as complete evidence.
Planning permission is not a protected-species licence.
A licence application is not a licence grant.
Proposed mitigation is not evidence of implementation.
District-level licensing coverage is not inferred from geography alone.
Monitoring commitments are not measured conservation outcomes.
No score or promotion is written without exact species, survey, licence, implementation and monitoring evidence.
